name: resistance band bent over row
description: A hinged rowing move with a band that works the muscles between and around the shoulder blades.
instructions: Stand on the middle of the band with feet hip-width apart and hold an end in each hand.
Hinge at the hips with a flat back until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Pull your elbows back toward your hips, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
